title: Treaty of Surji-Anjangaon
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Surji-Anjangaon", at revision 1380666708, opens: "The Treaty of Surji-Anjangaon was signed on 30 December 1803 between the British and Daulat Rao Sindhia, chief of the Maratha Confederacy at Anjangaon town located in Maharashtra." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q7837243, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1803 treaty between Great Britain and Maratha". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
